title: One look for Reed, Loomed, and Weft
question: The three apps share one system. Only the stamp changes: public, sealed, or explored. Keep this counter, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Counter slip
options.lineage: A numbered order slip on a quiet counter
options.thesis: Every post, message, and peer is one numbered row on the same counter. Chrome steps back.
options.viewport: Reed home: a narrow word column (Home, Discover, Compose, Search, Settings, Identity) and a single stack of numbered posts. Time is a short bar on the row, not a corner clock. The blue stamp is Reed. Loomed uses the same sheet with a violet stamp. Weft uses it with a green stamp, peers as numbered stops.
options.risk: A receipt feels cheap if the paper yellows or the numbers become decoration. Weft’s map becomes a route of stops, not a floating graph.

raised.raise: Time is a length on the row, not a timestamp tucked in the corner.
All three apps share one ground, one measure, and one type size. Only the stamp hue changes.
The row is the control. Selection floods the row. No extra button chrome.
One cell size. Nothing floats between the cells.

options.label: Railway timetable
options.thesis: Posts, threads, and peers are departures: time, name, status, one late mark.
options.viewport: Reed home as a departure sheet. A fixed time column, the author, the post, and a red mark only when the knot is unreachable. Loomed is the same sheet for private carriages. Weft is the route list of the knot and its peers.
options.risk: This is the familiar clean-modern landing. Black, white, and one red on a strict grid is where most of these redesigns end.

options.label: Pass and board
options.lineage: A segmented boarding pass beside a live gate board
options.thesis: You carry a pass. The board is the live list, and a changed row stays lit until you have seen it.
options.viewport: Reed: the pass across the top holds your name, a cropped did, and the knot. Below, posts sit in fixed columns of time, author, and text. A new row holds amber until Refresh. Loomed’s board is conversations. Weft’s board is peers.
options.case: Beats the slip on both counts. More people already know how to read a pass and a board, and the pass is the identity while the board is the feed.
options.risk: Turns into an airport costume if the pass grows a fake barcode. The did is text, not a picture of a code.

options.label: Split-flap board
options.thesis: The public list updates character by character. You watch it. You do not write on it.
options.viewport: Reed home as a full-bleed board of posts in fixed cells. Delayed knots go amber. Cancelled rows dim to red. Loomed and Weft reuse the same cells.
options.case: Holds recognition as a live public list. Loses as a place to write a post or sit in a private thread.
options.risk: The clack becomes the product, and the writing disappears.

options.label: Labanotation
options.viewport: Time runs upward. Actions are shaded blocks beside a center staff.
options.case: People opening a feed do not read a dance score, and the symbols hide the post.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.lineage: Five plates of one plant at one scale
options.viewport: Five aligned plates, one life stage each, captions beneath.
options.case: A social client is not a specimen sequence. Five plates do not hold an inbox.
options.risk: Pretty plates, no place to write.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.lineage: Flat tiles and giant cropped lowercase
options.viewport: A panorama of giant words. Tiles are the only doors.
options.case: The type becomes the interface and the post has nowhere to sit.
options.kept: Delete the button costume. The row is the control.

options.label: Grid specimen
options.viewport: Monumental letters built cell by cell. The poster is the proof.
options.case: The proof of these apps is the record, not the letterform.

canonCard.label: The usual client
canonCard.thesis: A left rail, a white stage, a blue accent, and a feed of cards. The social app people already expect.
canonCard.viewport: Reed home: icon sidebar, search on top, posts as rounded cards with a name and a line of text. Loomed is the same shell with message bubbles. Weft is the same shell with a chart.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other client, on purpose.
